name: mind
description: Chrona 核心主动智能：从真实使用证据理解用户、推进持续目标、调查能力缺口并核对实际成果；支持纠正、暂停和遗忘。

tools.name: updates
tools.description: Read current Mind outcomes and blockers for an original conversation. Only the bound Chat application may query its own source roots; no execution or external notification.

tools.name: context
tools.description: Read sourced user understanding, ongoing goals and source coverage. Scope is bounded; no Agent execution. Missing coverage remains unknown.

tools.name: overview
tools.description: Owner workspace: current understanding, continuing work, actual results, coverage and execution budget.

tools.name: detail
tools.description: Read one item with its actual evidence and saved local artifacts.

tools.name: settings
tools.description: Owner: read or versioned update learning, background, notification and retention settings; grants no tool permissions.
sideEffects: Writes versioned private Mind state or performs the specifically guarded local effect

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Record a sourced goal/preference/constraint/habit/environment. input JSON uses actionKey,expectedVisibilityRevision,expectedRevision,id?,kind,value,scope,explicitness,supportingRefs,opposingRefs?. User evidence required for explicit. scope is {} or an object with only projectId/sessionId string identifiers.
sideEffects: Writes versioned private Mind state or performs the specifically guarded local effect

tools.name: pursue
tools.description: Create or merge continuing outcome. input JSON actionKey,expectedVisibilityRevision,expectedRevision,semanticKey,goal,completionCriteria,scope,reason,evidenceRefs,understandingRefs?. Ordinary questions need no pursuit. scope is {} or an object with only projectId/sessionId string identifiers.
sideEffects: Writes versioned private Mind state or performs the specifically guarded local effect

tools.name: control
tools.description: Correct, pause, resume or end actual current item. input JSON kind,id,expectedRevision,expectedVisibilityRevision,operation,actionKey,evidenceRefs?,value?. Caller authority and user evidence checked.
sideEffects: Writes versioned private Mind state or performs the specifically guarded local effect

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Explicit user useful/not-useful/reject/restart feedback; input JSON targetKind,targetId,expectedRevision,expectedVisibilityRevision,value,scope,actionKey,evidenceRefs?. Silence never feedback. scope is {} or an object with only projectId/sessionId string identifiers.
sideEffects: Writes versioned private Mind state or performs the specifically guarded local effect

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Owner: withdraw evidence, understanding, source object or session from Mind only. input JSON target,expectedVisibilityRevision,actionKey. Does not erase original Chat/Provider/external effects.
sideEffects: Writes versioned private Mind state or performs the specifically guarded local effect

tools.name: progress
tools.description: Current Mind run only: save a candidate outcome, never verified completion. input JSON pursuitId,expectedRevision,expectedVisibilityRevision,summary,artifactRefs,originalReceiptRef,evidenceRefs,desiredStatus,nextStep?,waitReason?,actionKey.
sideEffects: Writes versioned private Mind state or performs the specifically guarded local effect

tools.name: action
tools.description: Create a version/actor-guarded local document, or invoke an owner-reviewed granted application read with target=application-read, adapterId and params. Both require pursuitId, expectedRevision, expectedVisibilityRevision and actionKey; returned canonical artifact refs may support independent result verification.
sideEffects: Writes versioned private Mind state or performs the specifically guarded local effect

tools.name: artifact
tools.description: Read exact persisted local document content and digest; original pursuit access remains required.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Owner asks for one source synchronization and bounded background check; does not grant new permissions.
sideEffects: Writes versioned private Mind state or performs the specifically guarded local effect

tools.name: verdict
tools.description: 记录当前独立验收 Run 的具体条件核对；真实调用身份及持久工具结果匹配后才可使用。

tools.name: recovery
tools.description: Owner-only: inspect backup restore guard, or explicitly authorize this exact restored memory after reviewing potentially outdated forget records. input JSON restoreId, expectedVisibilityRevision, decision: authorize-restored-memory. Not selected for autonomous agents.

tools.name: admission-verdict
tools.description: 独立语义验收 Run 返回与真实来源及候选绑定的判断；普通应用与调用参数不能授予身份。

tools.name: applications
tools.description: List reviewed exact application read adapters. input JSON operation list (default), or owner-only grant with moduleId, activeHash, tool, effect read, exact params and reviewed description; revoke with adapterId. Autonomous agents cannot grant or revoke. Use mind.action target application-read for a current pursuit and real persisted response.
sideEffects: Owner may configure or revoke exact reviewed application reads

tools.name: delivery
tools.description: Current kernel-bound worker: prepare exact NEW Author material with pursuit/revisions, actionKey, author identity, admissionId, requestKey, items (name, dir, intent, materialDigest), criteria; finish for authenticated proof capture. Actual owner/approved Web only: list (limit,after), detail/submit/reconcile/withdraw/forget (id). Explicit submit verifies original admission and stages; unknown replies query the original receipt. Activation never completes the goal. No JSON owner/access fields.
sideEffects: Persists exact private delivery preparation and authenticated stage/admission proof
Only an explicit actual-owner submit transports the original staged material to Author; reconcile reads its original receipt
